mesh.note: uniform on the sphere: rows of constant latitude spacing, each holding as many cells as fit round its own parallel

method.interpolation: distance-weighted circular mean of the doubled azimuth
method.note: cells are painted flat and not smoothed, so the resolution of the interpolation is visible rather than hidden behind a gradient
